$comment: 语法大厅 G19（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：中文认为万物不可数，英文只认一半。与 KET 八课 L8 共用说法（L8 原文：中文认为万物不可数，所以全要量词：一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水。英文只认一半：书鱼苹果自己能数，水面包米不能数，要借杯子袋子；many/much/a lot of 分工），L8 零改动。与 G01（可数/不可数分队）衔接：G01 管「谁能数」，本课管「数不清的怎么数」。全部内容原创。
title: 量词与不可数搭配
metaphor: 中文认为万物不可数，英文只认一半
ketNote: many/much/a lot of、some/any、How many/How much 是 KET Part 5 的常驻考点；a piece of bread 这类容器搭配在听力购物场景里反复出现。八课里的亲戚是 L8。

sections.essence: 中文认为万物不可数；英文只认一半——数不清的，借杯子袋子来数。
sections.why: 中文数东西，什么都要过一道量词：一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水、一「张」纸——在中文的世界观里，万物都不可数，都得借量词才数得成。英文只认一半：书、鱼、苹果这些「能一个一个摆出来」的，自己就会报数——two books、three fish 摆好就行；可水、面包、米这些摊开一片的，英文也数不动，只好走中文的老路——借容器：a glass of water、a piece of bread、a bag of rice。所以这一课对中国孩子其实是「回家」：借杯子袋子这套你天生就会，难的只有两件事——记住英文哪一半不用借（别说 a paper of...），以及配对的小词各就各位：many 配数得清，much 配数不清，a lot of 两边通吃；a few 配数得清，a little 配数不清；How many 问个数，How much 问分量和价钱。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团演出成功，庆功宴的采购交给了乐务老师和小凡。小凡先用中文列单子：三把椅子、两张桌布、十瓶水、两条面包——他忽然发现，中文里每样东西都挂着量词，「把、张、瓶、条」，一个都逃不掉，仿佛万物都数不清，全要借个家什才数得成。翻译成英文购物单时，老师教他：「英文只认一半。椅子、苹果、鸡蛋自己会报数——three chairs、twenty apples，直接写数字加复数；水、面包、果汁这一半数不动，跟中文一样要借家什——ten bottles of water、two loaves of bread，注意瓶子多了 bottles 自己变复数。」到了超市，老师又教两句口诀：数得清的问 How many eggs，数不清的问 How much juice；拿不准多还是少，a lot of 两边通吃。付账前小凡想给大家加个菜，脱口而出：Can we have a chicken?——老师赶紧拦住：「a chicken 是『一整只鸡』！你想说的是 some chicken，一些鸡肉。差一个 a，端上来的东西可就不一样了。」

cards.detail: 能一个一个摆出来的自己报数（two books, three eggs）；水、面包、米这类摊开一片的数不动，要借容器。
cards.example: two books ✓ / two waters ✗ → two bottles of water

cards.detail: a glass/cup/bottle/bowl of + 液体；a piece/slice/loaf of + 面包类；a bag/box/kilo of + 米糖等。数量多时容器自己变复数。
cards.example: a cup of tea / two pieces of bread / three bags of rice

cards.detail: 数得清的用 many，数不清的用 much，a lot of 两边通吃——拿不准就用它。
cards.example: many chairs / much milk / a lot of chairs·milk

cards.detail: 「几个」配数得清 → a few；「一点儿」配数不清 → a little。
cards.example: a few coins / a little salt

cards.detail: 肯定句用 some；否定句和疑问句一般用 any（客气地给别人东西时问句也用 some）。
cards.example: I have some juice. / I don't have any juice. / Would you like some tea?

cards.detail: How many + 复数问个数；How much + 不可数问分量——问价钱也是 How much。
cards.example: How many eggs? / How much milk? / How much is it?

basic.en: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
basic.cn: 请给我一杯橙汁。（借杯子）

basic.en: There are five chairs around the table.
basic.cn: 桌子周围有五把椅子。（chairs 自己报数）

basic.en: Mum bought two bags of rice this morning.
basic.cn: 妈妈今早买了两袋米。（借袋子，bags 变复数）

basic.en: We need a piece of paper for the game.
basic.cn: 游戏要用一张纸。（paper 借 piece）

basic.en: He eats a bowl of noodles every morning.

mid.en: How many bottles of water do we need for the picnic?
mid.cn: 野餐我们需要几瓶水？（问个数——数瓶子）

mid.en: There isn't much juice left, but there are a lot of apples.
mid.cn: 果汁不多了，但苹果有很多。（much 配果汁，a lot of 通吃）

mid.en: Could I have two slices of bread and a little butter?
mid.cn: 能给我两片面包和一点黄油吗？

mid.en: She put a few strawberries and a little honey in the bowl.
mid.cn: 她往碗里放了几颗草莓和一点蜂蜜。（a few 配可数，a little 配不可数）

mid.en: Is there any milk in the fridge?
mid.cn: 冰箱里还有牛奶吗？（疑问句用 any）

trap.note: some chicken 是鸡肉；a chicken 是一整只鸡——差一个 a，端上来的不一样。

trap.en: The window is made of glass.
trap.note: glass 不加 a 是「玻璃」这种材料；a glass 是一只杯子。

trap.en: I have too much homework today.
trap.note: homework 数不清——much homework，永远别说 many homeworks。

trap.en: We need three kilos of bananas.
trap.note: 香蕉自己可数，但论斤称时借 kilo——kilos 变复数。
客气地请人吃喝，问句也用 some——这是 any 规则的礼貌例外。

trap.en: There is a little time before the show, so let's check the list.
trap.cn: 开演前还有一点时间，我们对一遍清单吧。
trap.note: time（时间）数不清——a little time，不是 a few time。

redBlack.bad: Can we have a chicken, please?（想点一份鸡肉）
redBlack.good: Can we have some chicken, please?
redBlack.why: a chicken 是一整只鸡——加不加 a，端上桌的东西完全不同。

redBlack.bad: The bottle is made of a glass.（想说玻璃做的）
redBlack.good: The bottle is made of glass.
redBlack.why: a glass 是一只杯子——「瓶子是用一只杯子做的」让人摸不着头脑。

redBlack.bad: How much apples do you want?
redBlack.good: How many apples do you want?
redBlack.why: apples 自己报数——问个数用 How many。

redBlack.bad: There isn't many milk in the fridge.
redBlack.good: There isn't much milk in the fridge.
redBlack.why: milk 数不清——many 只配数得清的。

redBlack.bad: I ate three breads for breakfast.
redBlack.good: I ate three pieces of bread for breakfast.
redBlack.why: bread 数不动，要借 piece——三片是 three pieces of bread。

redBlack.bad: She bought two bottle of water.
redBlack.good: She bought two bottles of water.
redBlack.why: 借来的容器自己要变复数——two bottles。

redBlack.good: I have much homework tonight. / I have a lot of homework tonight.
redBlack.why: homework 数不清也没有复数——much/a lot of homework。

redBlack.bad: There is a few water in the kettle.
redBlack.good: There is a little water in the kettle.
redBlack.why: water 数不清——「一点儿」用 a little，a few 配数得清的。

redBlack.bad: I don't have some money with me.
redBlack.good: I don't have any money with me.
redBlack.why: 否定句里 some 要换成 any。

redBlack.good: Please give me two bowls of rice.
redBlack.why: rice 数不动——借碗：two bowls of rice。

redBlack.good: 口语点单说 Two coffees 完全可以（＝two cups of coffee）。
redBlack.why: 餐馆里论「份」点单是通行说法——意思不挡，考试也不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: I like fruits.（有人说必须用 fruit）
redBlack.good: I like fruit. / 说不同种类时 fruits 也对。
redBlack.why: fruit 通常整体不可数；强调各种水果时 fruits 也通——不挡不考。

contrast.cn: 一本书、一条鱼、一杯水。（万物都要量词）
contrast.en: a book, a fish, a glass of water（书和鱼自己报数）
contrast.diff: 中文认为万物不可数，全要量词；英文只认一半——只有水这一半要借杯子。

contrast.cn: 很多书、很多水。（「很多」通用）
contrast.diff: 中文一个「很多」走天下；英语要先问「数得清吗」再挑 many 或 much。

contrast.cn: 几本书、一点水。（「几」和「一点」）
contrast.en: a few books / a little water
contrast.diff: 中文凭语感选「几／一点」；英语把同一条可数线又画了一遍——a few 对 a little。

contrast.cn: 多少本？多少钱？（都是「多少」）
contrast.en: How many books? / How much is it?
contrast.diff: 中文一个「多少」；英语按可数分成 How many 和 How much，问价钱归 How much。

contrast.en: two bags of rice（bag 变复数 + of）
contrast.diff: 借家什这招中英相同；英语多两个零件——容器变复数，后面接 of。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先问数得清吗：清则 many/few/How many；浑则 much/little/How much；借家什记得变复数，a lot of 两边通吃。
steps: 看名词：能一个一个摆出来吗？能 → 自己报数（复数）；不能 → 借容器（a glass/piece/bag of）。
容器数量超过一，容器自己变复数：two cups of tea。
选搭配小词：数得清 → many / a few / How many；数不清 → much / a little / How much。
拿不准多少？a lot of 两边通吃。
否定和疑问句把 some 换成 any（客气请人吃喝除外）。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，中文里咱们数什么都要带量词：一本书、一条鱼、一杯水——好像万物都数不清。英文偷懒，只认一半：书、苹果自己会报数，two books 就完事；水、面包、米跟中文一样要借家什——a glass of water 一杯水，a piece of bread 一片面包。晚饭时咱们玩『报菜名』：桌上每样东西你用英语报个数——鸡蛋直接数 two eggs，米饭要借碗 a bowl of rice。我不懂英语没关系，我只问一句：这样东西自己会报数，还是要借杯子袋子？」去超市可以升级：让她算「要买几瓶水」用 How many bottles，问「牛奶要多少」用 How much milk——说错不纠正，回家查了明天再问一次。
questions: 中文数东西都要量词，英文哪一半不用借？举两个例子。
「三片面包」英语怎么说？bread 前面能直接写 three 吗？
问「几个苹果」和「多少牛奶」，开头分别用哪两个词？

sections.echo: 可数和不可数的边界不是天生的，是人心里画的——而且会挪动。英语里的豌豆本来叫 pease，跟 rice 一样是数不清的一锅糊糊；可 pease 的尾音听着太像复数了，几百年前人们想当然地把它「拆」出一个单数——pea 就这么被造了出来，豌豆从此排进了可数的队伍。反过来，news 明明长着复数的 s，却是不可数的（G01 讲过它的化石 s）。所以别把可数表当成物理定律去背——它是一部还在改写的习惯法：常用的搭配说得多了，就成了「对」的那一个。

stages.name: 认一认 · 谁要借家什

questions.q: 下面哪样东西自己会报数？
questions.explain: 鸡蛋能一个一个摆出来——two eggs 直接数。

questions.q: 下面哪样东西要借容器才数得成？
questions.explain: 牛奶摊开一片数不动——a glass of milk。

questions.q: 「一杯水」英语怎么说？
questions.explain: 借杯子——a glass of water。

questions.q: 「一片面包」英语怎么说？
questions.explain: bread 借 piece——a piece of bread。

questions.q: 「一袋米」英语怎么说？
questions.explain: 借袋子——a bag of rice。

questions.q: 「两瓶果汁」里 bottle 要变吗？
questions.explain: 借来的容器自己变复数——bottles。

questions.q: 数得清的「很多」用哪个词？
questions.explain: many + 复数——many chairs。

questions.q: 数不清的「很多」用哪个词？
questions.explain: much + 不可数——much milk。

questions.q: 哪个词「两边通吃」，可数不可数都能配？
questions.explain: 拿不准就用 a lot of。

questions.q: 「几个」（少量、数得清）用哪个？
questions.explain: a few coins——数得清的少量。

questions.q: 「一点儿」（少量、数不清）用哪个？
questions.explain: a little salt——数不清的少量。

questions.q: 问「几个鸡蛋」用哪个开头？
questions.explain: eggs 数得清——How many eggs。

questions.q: 问「多少牛奶」用哪个开头？
questions.explain: milk 数不清——How much milk。

questions.q: 问价钱「多少钱」用哪个？
questions.explain: How much is it?——价钱归 How much 管。

questions.q: 否定句里的 some 要换成？
questions.explain: I don't have any...——否定用 any。

questions.q: homework（作业）属于哪一半？
questions.explain: homework 不可数没有复数——much homework。

questions.q: We need ___ for the party — about twenty!
questions.explain: 气球数得清——many balloons。

questions.q: There isn't ___ honey left in the jar.
questions.explain: honey 数不清——much。

questions.q: Please buy ___ of milk on your way home.
questions.explain: 容器变复数——two bottles of milk。

questions.q: I'd like ___ of tomato soup, please.
questions.explain: 汤借碗——a bowl of soup。

questions.q: Can I have ___ of cheese on my sandwich?
questions.explain: 奶酪切片——a slice of cheese。

questions.q: How ___ sugar do we need for the cake?
questions.explain: sugar 数不清——How much。

questions.q: How ___ oranges are there in the basket?
questions.explain: oranges 数得清——How many。

questions.q: There are ___ strawberries left — only three or four.
questions.explain: 三四颗＝数得清的少量——a few。

questions.q: Add ___ salt to the soup — just a spoonful.
questions.explain: 一小勺＝数不清的少量——a little。

questions.q: Do we have ___ eggs for the pancakes?
questions.explain: 疑问句用 any——Do we have any eggs?

questions.q: I bought ___ bread — two loaves.
questions.explain: 肯定句用 some——some bread。

questions.q: Would you like ___ tea, Grandma?
questions.explain: 客气请人喝茶——问句也用 some。

questions.q: He drinks ___ of water after every match.
questions.explain: a lot of water——通吃词组的固定长相。

questions.q: Mum bought three ___ for the picnic.
questions.explain: 论斤借 kilo，容器变复数——three kilos of grapes。

questions.q: There's only ___ time before the guests arrive!
questions.explain: time 数不清——a little time。

questions.q: We don't need ___ chairs — most people will stand.
questions.explain: chairs 数得清——not many chairs。

stages.name: 改一改 · 宴会单纠错

questions.q: 哪句点菜不会闹笑话？
options: I'd like a chicken, please.（想要一份鸡肉）
I'd like chickens, please.（想要一份鸡肉）
questions.explain: some chicken 是鸡肉；a chicken 会端上一整只鸡。

questions.q: 哪句的「玻璃」说对了？
options: The vase is made of glass.
The vase is made of a glass.
The vase is made of glasses.
questions.explain: 材料不加 a——glass；a glass 是一只杯子。

questions.q: 哪句的面包数对了？
options: She ate two pieces of bread.
She ate two piece of bread.
questions.explain: 借 piece 且变复数——two pieces of bread。

questions.q: 哪句的提问选对了开头？
options: How many bananas do you want?
How much bananas do you want?
How many banana do you want?
questions.explain: bananas 数得清——How many + 复数。

questions.q: 哪句的牛奶问对了？
options: How much milk is there in the fridge?
How many milk is there in the fridge?
How many milks are there in the fridge?
questions.explain: milk 数不清——How much。

questions.q: 哪句的作业说对了？
options: I have a lot of homework tonight.
I have a few homework tonight.
questions.explain: homework 不可数——a lot of / much homework。

questions.q: 哪句的否定句合规？
options: We don't have any juice left.
We don't have some juice left.
We don't have a juice left.
questions.explain: 否定句 some 换 any。

questions.q: 哪句的「一点水」说对了？
options: There is a little water in the vase.
There is a few water in the vase.
There are a little waters in the vase.
questions.explain: water 数不清——a little water。

questions.q: 哪句的米饭端得上桌？
questions.explain: 借碗且碗变复数——two bowls of rice。

questions.q: 哪句的茶点对了？
questions.explain: cups 变复数——three cups of tea。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（几张纸）
options: I need a few pieces of paper.
I need a few papers piece.
I need a little pieces of paper.
questions.explain: pieces 数得清——a few pieces of paper。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（钱不多）
options: He doesn't have a few money.
questions.explain: money 数不清——much money。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（果汁太多了）
options: There is too much juice in the cup.
There are too many juice in the cup.
There is too many juices in the cup.
questions.explain: juice 数不清——too much。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（有几个朋友要来）
options: A few friends are coming to dinner.
A little friends are coming to dinner.
A few friend is coming to dinner.
questions.explain: friends 数得清——a few friends。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（请人吃蛋糕）
options: Would you like any cake?（唯一正确）
Would you like a cake much?
questions.explain: 客气请人吃喝——some；这是 any 规则的礼貌例外。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（一点新闻）
options: There is a little news about the concert.
There are a few news about the concert.
There is a few newses about the concert.
questions.explain: news 数不清（那个 s 是化石）——a little news。

stages.name: 用一用 · 庆功宴现场

questions.q: 购物单：___ eggs, ___ milk, and a lot of apples.
questions.explain: 鸡蛋自己报数；牛奶借瓶子——two bottles of milk。

questions.q: — ___ do we need for the fruit salad? — About six, and ___ honey.
questions.explain: oranges 数得清 How many；蜂蜜数不清 a little。

questions.q: — Is there ___ soup left? — Yes, but only ___.
questions.explain: 疑问句 any；汤数不清——剩 a little。

questions.q: We have ___ chairs but not ___ space, so let's move the table.
questions.explain: 椅子多 a lot of；空间数不清 not much space。

questions.q: Waiter: What would you like? — ___ chicken and ___ rice, please.
questions.explain: 点鸡肉 some chicken；米饭借碗 two bowls of rice。

questions.q: — ___ is the watermelon? — Ten yuan a kilo. We need ___ kilos.
questions.explain: 问价钱 How much；论斤 three kilos。

questions.q: There isn't ___ bread, so please buy two ___.
questions.explain: bread 数不清 not much；整条面包借 loaf——loaves。

questions.q: I put ___ strawberries and ___ sugar into the bowl, and mixed them.
questions.explain: 草莓数得清 a few；糖数不清 a little。

questions.q: — Do you have ___ questions? — Just one: how ___ water should I add?
questions.explain: 疑问句 any questions；水数不清 how much。

questions.q: Guests are coming! We need ___ of juice and ___ of paper for the games.
questions.explain: bottles、pieces 两个容器都要变复数。

questions.q: — There's too ___ noise in the kitchen! — Sorry, we dropped ___ of spoons.
questions.explain: noise 数不清 too much；一盒勺子 a box of spoons。

questions.q: My little sister drank ___ orange juice and ate ___ grapes.
options: a lot of / a lot of
questions.explain: a lot of 两边通吃——果汁和葡萄都能配。

questions.q: — How ___ cheese do we need? — ___ slices, for the sandwiches.
questions.explain: cheese 数不清 How much；回答换成数片 six slices。

questions.q: Don't worry — there's still ___ time, and we only need ___ minutes more.
questions.explain: time 数不清 a little；minutes 数得清 a few。

questions.q: — I can't find ___ napkins. — Look in the cupboard, there are ___ boxes there.
questions.explain: 否定找不到 any；肯定有 some boxes。

questions.q: 大考：For the picnic we need ___ sandwiches, ___ of water, and ___ fruit.
options: a lot of / five bottles / some
questions.explain: 三明治通吃 a lot of；five bottles of water 容器变复数；肯定句 some fruit——三关一次过。

detective.sentence: I drank two waters after the match.
detective.fixed: I drank two bottles of water after the match.
detective.clue: water 数不动——要借瓶子，two bottles of water。

detective.sentence: How much stickers do you have in your album?
detective.fixed: How many stickers do you have in your album?
detective.clue: stickers 自己报数——问个数用 How many。

detective.sentence: There isn't many time before the bus leaves.
detective.fixed: There isn't much time before the bus leaves.
detective.clue: time 数不清——many 只配数得清的，用 much。

detective.sentence: Mum bought three bag of flour for the cake.
detective.fixed: Mum bought three bags of flour for the cake.
detective.clue: 借来的容器自己要变复数——three bags。

detective.sentence: I have too many homework this weekend.
detective.fixed: I have too much homework this weekend.
detective.clue: homework 数不清也没有复数——too much homework。

detective.sentence: We don't have some glue for the art class.
detective.fixed: We don't have any glue for the art class.
detective.clue: 否定句里 some 要换成 any。

detective.sentence: Please put a few butter on my toast.
detective.fixed: Please put a little butter on my toast.
detective.clue: butter 数不清——「一点儿」用 a little，a few 配数得清的。
